mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRIP_EVENTS ( userId, tripId, routeStepId, eventType, eventMessage, lat, lng, autoSentYn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{tripId}, #{routeStepId}, #{eventType}, #{eventMessage}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{autoSentYn} )
INSERT INTO NOTIFICATIONS ( receiverId, tripEventId, notifyType, content ) VALUES ( #{receiverId}, #{tripEventId}, #{notifyType}, #{content} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.tripId FROM TRIPS t INNER JOIN ROUTES r ON r.routeId = t.routeId WHERE r.userId = #{userId} AND t.tripStatus = 'MOVING' ORDER BY t.startDt DESC LIMIT 1
